 SMART HUB Logistics 

 23 juli 2026

# Zeeland Sugar Terminal opent nieuw warehouse voor groeiende suikerimport

Peter de Weerd

9 september 2026

 

 Foto ter illustratie

Zeeland Sugar Terminal (ZST) breidt zijn logistieke capaciteit uit met een nieuw magazijn van 5.000 vierkante meter. Met de investering speelt ZST in op een verwachte groei van de suikerimport naar West-Europa.

Het nieuwe magazijn beschikt onder meer over scantechnologie, laadperrons en uitgebreide beveiligingsvoorzieningen. Daarnaast is er capaciteit beschikbaar voor de opslag van biologische suiker.

## Bulk, afzakken en opslag gecombineerd

Een belangrijk voordeel is de directe verbinding met de bestaande faciliteiten van Zeeland Sugar Terminal voor het lossen van bulksuiker en het afzakken van suiker. Hierdoor kunnen klanten verschillende logistieke activiteiten op één locatie combineren. Geïmporteerde suiker kan als bulk worden aangevoerd, vervolgens worden afgezakt en daarna direct in het nieuwe warehouse worden opgeslagen.

Daarmee breidt ZST zijn dienstverlening uit tot een geïntegreerde logistieke oplossing voor suikerimporteurs en andere partijen

SJH Fulfilment invests £3.5m in Greater Belfast expansion · BUSINESSFIRST

# SJH Fulfilment invests £3.5m in Greater Belfast expansion

 September 7, 2026 

 

SJH Fulfilment has announced a £3.5 million investment in a new 46,000 sq ft Greater Belfast fulfilment facility, more than doubling its total warehousing footprint and supporting 25 permanent jobs at the site within the next three years.

The new facility takes the company’s total warehousing footprint in Northern Ireland to 83,500 sq ft, up from 37,500 sq ft at its Kilkeel base. The additional capacity will support larger fulfilment contracts across the fashion, wellness and beauty sectors, while marking the launch of a new 10-year growth strategy targeting revenues of £50 million by 2036. Five full-time employees have already been recruited at the new site, with a further 20 permanent roles expected to be created over the next three years. An additional 10 seasonal positions will be added this winter.

## SJH Fulfilment

The company has also secured a significant contract for the site with a multi-billion-dollar US-based brand, which is consolidating its Great Britain and EU warehousing operations through Northern Ireland

# Raben Greece strengthens its presence in Thessaloniki

2026.09.01

Raben Logistics Greece announced the launch of operations at its new 4,000 sq.m. logistics centre in Sindos, Thessaloniki, marking an important step in Raben Group’s growth trajectory in the Greek market.

The new facilities have been developed on a privately owned 50,000 sq.m. plot and form part of Raben Group’s €10 million strategic investment in Northern Greece. The first phase of the investment includes a modern 4,000 sq.m. cross-dock warehouse with 40 loading and unloading docks, a refrigerated chamber for fresh food products, as well as new office space with a total area of 1,200 sq.m.

The operation of the new logistics centre significantly strengthens Raben Greece’s operational capabilities, supporting the further development of its services in Contract Logistics, Domestic Transport and Temperature-Controlled Food Logistics (TCL). October 15, 2026

Edgistify timed the launch for the festive season, the busiest time of the year for consumer brands. Its two existing Gurugram sites are full, so Luhari gives brands one place to stock up early instead of spreading inventory across several partners when demand peaks. # Wagner Logistics to Add Nearly 80 Jobs with New High-Volume Logistics Operation in Liberty

 Wagner Logistics 

Oct 14, 2026, 08:54 ET

NORTH KANSAS CITY, Mo., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wagner Logistics, a nationwide provider of third-party logistics, today announced it has signed a multi-year agreement with a Kansas City-area manufacturer to launch a new manufacturing support and warehouse operations program in Liberty, Mo.

The new operation includes two leased warehouse facilities in the Liberty area totaling more than 830,000 square feet. Wagner expects to add 79 new local jobs over the next two years, starting immediately. The company will also make a multi-million-dollar investment in equipment, infrastructure and automated trailer loading and unloading technology to support the operation.

"This is exactly the kind of operation where Wagner's strengths come through," said Brian Smith, President and Chief Executive Officer of Wagner Logistics. "It requires speed, flexibility, close coordination and the ability to design a solution around what the customer actually needs."

# RGL Logistics unveils new warehouse in Appleton

Added capacity needed to support region’s manufacturers, company says

RGL prioritizes career development, Michelle Wellens said, while also offering paid opportunities for community volunteer work. Submitted Photo

 

Judith Munson

Contributor

October 5, 2026

APPLETON – RGL Logistics is making moves again.

The Green Bay-based company recently completed construction on a new warehouse at its Appleton campus, marking its 29th building to join its three-campus network. 

Michelle Wellens, director of transportation solutions and marketing, said the new building adds 427,500 square feet to the company’s total footprint of more than 4 million square feet, which covers all three RGL sites in Neenah, Green Bay and Appleton.

Wellens said the warehouse was built to create additional capacity and flexibility on RGL’s Appleton campus, while continuing to respond to customers’ needs.
